qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global bottler ecosystem of ~200 independent partners serving over 30 million retail outlets creates unmatchable distribution scale, high route density, and pervasive cold-drink placement. Empirical moat proof: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 17.5%, tangible operating ROIC of 26.0%, and gross margins consistently maintained at 58-61%. Demonstrated consistent pricing power via incidence-based concentrate pricing contracts with price/mix gains of 11% (2022), 10% (2023), 10% (2024), and 4% (2025) while preserving unit volumes. Primary erosion risks: adverse outcome in the Eleventh Circuit IRS transfer-pricing appeal extending to post-2009 tax years, and evolving dietary shifts away from sugar (hedged via Coke Zero Sugar and non-CSD category expansion).
qualitative.note: Asset-light concentrate toll booth on global non-alcoholic beverage consumption with entrenched brand power and massive scale economies shared across ~200 bottling partners. Demonstrated pricing power across high-inflation cycles via incidence-based contracts. Structurally insulated across all 5 macrotrends. Net debt at 2.4x net income with 8.3x interest coverage; $6B IRS deposit already paid with manageable ongoing legal risk on appeal. qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 17.5% and tangible operating ROIC of 26.0% in FY2025. Gross margins steady between 58% and 61% across cycles despite severe commodity and packaging swings. Refranchising of capital-intensive bottling operations transformed KO into a high-margin (28-29% EBIT margin), asset-light cash engine. Demonstrated exceptional pricing power with non-GAAP price/mix up 11% in 2022, 10% in 2023, 10% in 2024, and 4% in 2025 alongside stable unit case volumes. 10-year cumulative Owner FCF conversion exceeds 92% (approaching ~99% normalizing for the $6.0B IRS tax deposit in 2024). Net debt of $31.8B is 2.43x FY2025 net income ($13.1B) and interest coverage is 8.3x EBIT ($13.8B / $1.65B), comfortably supporting the 60+ year dividend growth streak.
